text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories. For example, some programs generate paintings in seconds, while others help musicians find new melodies. However, AI works differently from humans. It learns from existing data and produces results based on patterns. Human creativity, on the other hand, comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. While AI can support artists and writers, it cannot truly feel or understand what it creates. So, maybe the best results happen when humans and machines work together.
